dependency_acquisition: Wheel-only fetch into a copied owned venv; no source distribution, target import or build hook execution. Review exact primary release digests, licenses, hatch-vcs/setuptools-scm version behavior and native uv scripts before installation.
proposed_workflow: Explicit owned config with mode local, template license IDs empty and headers false. Interactive new --init on an owned simple pyproject.toml; assert resulting metadata and preserved sentinel/config. Additional ordinary built-in project creation cases may use the same license-disabled configuration after dependency/plugin review.
